Page 146 Cont.
Aug. 7th Casimiera Kostecka - 23 - ear-trouble - mastoid operation when 7 yrs. old - hearing poor ever since. Promises more frequent Holy Com. - twice a yr .-
Page 147
Aug. 8th Robert Molloy - 25 - Dying a yr ago last February ... lingered on back. Enrolled June 21st and prayed for here at these devotions - August 10th last year was improving - in fact trying to learn to walk again. To- day is reported back home in Ireland from Glasgo Scotland practically, Okay - Expects to go back to work in September. Deo Gr.
Mrs. Eleanor Steffes - 35 - peculiar dizzy spells, in Mayo's now under observation.
Harry Baker - 50 - "creeping" or
Douglas Allor - 52 - serious Stomach-ulcers ... suffering for ten yrs.
9 Mrs. Eleanor Deguvera - 45 - of Romeo Mich. - Infection in leg - broken in 4 places .... can walk again ....
Loftus - Dying man fearing relative - heart - Fr. Cyr. gave Bl. - improved ....
R. Filipiok - 1 yrs. Brain maningitis
Pauline Searaiec - 28 - Asthma - 2 small baby
Page 148
Aug. 17 Mary Ellen - 4 - of Chicago 3132 76th Ave. - sleeping sickness - "brain tuomer irreparably scarred - since March 25, 1938 .... Scienti- fically hopeless. Parents here To-day, having driven all night to Enroll her - promising at same time to read "City of God".
Maurice Christens - 50 - operated on for Cancer a year ago ... Threa- tened now with same thing again ....
18 Mrs. Genevieve Eatherly - 56 - small operation last May for tuomer - Xrayed again and again since - 24 - altogether. Now worse than ever - burned ... gives up treatments and Enrolled in Ser. Mass As.
John O'Toole - 51 - intestinal cancer in Eloise. Operation on August 12 abandon'd as simply hopeless. Enrolled To-night.
